mapper.select: SELECT l.LIFE_ID, l.MEMBER_ID, l.GUEST_TOKEN, l.STATUS, l.CURRENT_AGE, NVL(l.ASSETS, 0) AS ASSETS, (SELECT MAX(s.GDP_PER_CAPITA) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY ABS(s.DECADE - TRUNC((l.BIRTH_YEAR + l.CURRENT_AGE) / 10) * 10)) FROM COUNTRY_STAT s WHERE s.COUNTRY_CODE = l.CURRENT_COUNTRY AND s.GDP_PER_CAPITA IS NOT NULL) AS GDP_PER_CAPITA FROM LIFE l WHERE l.LIFE_ID = #{lifeId}

SELECT c.COSTUME_ID, c.COSTUME_NAME, c.PART, c.PRICE_RATE, c.IMAGE_PATH AS LOOK, CASE WHEN lc.COSTUME_ID IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS OWNED, NVL(lc.IS_EQUIPPED, 'N') AS EQUIPPED FROM COSTUME c LEFT JOIN LIFE_COSTUME lc ON lc.COSTUME_ID = c.COSTUME_ID AND lc.LIFE_ID = #{lifeId} ORDER BY c.PART, c.PRICE_RATE, c.COSTUME_ID
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LIFE_COSTUME WHERE LIFE_ID = #{lifeId} AND COSTUME_ID = #{costumeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LIFE_COSTUME (LIFE_ID, COSTUME_ID, PAID_AMOUNT, BOUGHT_AGE, IS_EQUIPPED) VALUES (#{lifeId}, #{costumeId}, #{price}, #{age}, 'N')
mapper.update: UPDATE LIFE_COSTUME SET IS_EQUIPPED = 'N' WHERE LIFE_ID = #{lifeId} AND IS_EQUIPPED = 'Y' AND COSTUME_ID IN (SELECT COSTUME_ID FROM COSTUME WHERE PART = #{part})
